hooks.command: if [[ "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" == *.py ]]; then uv run ruff check --fix "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" 2>&1 && uv run ruff format "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" 2>&1; fi
if [[ "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" == *.json ]]; then python3 -c "import json,sys; json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))" "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" 2>&1 || { echo "❌ Invalid JSON: $CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" >&2; exit 1; }; fi
